Reason for Mistake: The agent compiled and compared inconsistent metrics—using VONG’s cumulative total return (419.5%) while using annualized returns for VGT (22.47%) and MGK (18.22%). This apples-to-oranges comparison misled the final decision. The agent should have used the same basis (e.g., total return over 2013–2023) for all three ETFs; on a comparable basis, VGT had the highest percentage increase.
